text:
maya: Quick idea — rooftop microchallenge at 12:10 today? 10 min EMOM kettlebell + 10 min campus board technique swap. Low-key, bring chalk if you want. :muscle:
samir: Wait campus board on the roof?? 😅 Is there actually one up there or you bringing a portable setup?
kai: Not bringing a full board. I can rig the hangboard + small rungs near the maintenance wall. Good for pull + contact drills.
ryan: I can bring a 12kg and 16kg KB. EMOM idea sounds fun. What's the EMOM structure?
maya: EMOM (every minute on the minute) — alternate KB swings + plank holds. Example:
```
Minute 1: 12 KB swings (Russian)
Minute 2: 45s plank
Minute 3: 10 KB goblet squats
Minute 4: 45s hollow hold
Repeat x3
```
tori: Love it. Can we scale? 8kg for me pls. Also down for hangboard footwork drills after.
fitness-bot: Reminder: rooftop booking required for groups >4 — request submitted by @maya at 11:54. Status: pending.
maya: thanks bot. Will keep it under 10 and masks optional. @kai can you bring a spare pad?
kai: Yep spare pad + a tape measure (for campus board reach cues).
samir: I might be late by 10. If so grab me a KB and I'll join mid-EMOM.
ryan: Seth from ops said it's cool as long as we stack chairs back and avoid the green roof planters. :seedling:
maya: Plan: meet 12:10, start 12:15. Quick sign-up: maya, samir (maybe), kai, ryan, tori. If anyone else wants in, drop a 👍.
tori: 👍
ryan: 👍
samir: 👍 (prob show)
maya: Sweet. Quick note: bring sunscreen if you're outdoors. Also FYI — if rain, fallback to small conference room B.
maya: See y'all there! :sunglasses:
